description: 44 steps with a survival player (naturalRegeneration off, difficulty normal) and a creative one beside her: instant damage I, twice at once and for 3 ticks (the hurt cooldown), instant health I and II, at full health and for 3 ticks, regeneration I (snapshots between its heals), II and VI, poison I and III (every other hit kept out) and at low health (down to 1), wither I and III, wither V and instant damage IV until she dies (the death messages, the death animation, the body kept until the respawn), a fall of 10 blocks, hunger L, saturation I and III, the effects on the creative player (no damage), and starvation; each step's health packets, damage events (raw type ids), velocity, entity events, hurt, death and fall sounds, effect packets, removals and spawns for both players; Circuit and both official servers give identical output (the block's fall sound and the operator levels left out)
